children: Turkey’s manufacturing capacity utilization rate rose to 74.5% in October 2026 from 74.2% in the previous month, marking the highest rate recorded since June 2026.
The increase was supported by higher utilization across most major industry groupings, particularly consumer goods, where the rate climbed to 72.3% from 71.4% in the previous month.
Non-durable consumer goods utilization increased to 73.1% from 72.5%, while durable consumer goods rebounded to 68.5% from 66.4%.
Investment goods utilization also rose to 73.4% from 73.1%, indicating improved capacity usage in industries producing capital goods.
Meanwhile, intermediate goods utilization edged down to 74.4% from 74.5%, although remaining the highest among the main industry groupings.

title: Turkey Factory Capacity Usage Rises in October
